'''RENNSPORT''' was announced as part of the line-up on December 20, 2024, acting as the finale to the Rennsport R1 Spring Season.{{Cite web|url=https://x.com/EWC_EN/status/1870121991505654143 |title=#Rennsport is here for #EWC2025 🏁|date=2024-12-20 |author=Esports World Cup|language={{FlagNoLink|usuk}} English}} :''See [https://liquipedia.net/esports/Esports_World_Cup/2025 here] to read about the Esports World Cup 2025, the Calendar, the Club Standings and more.'' ===Format=== * '''Last Chance Stage - ''July 8th, 2025'' ** 4th-9th Place in [[Rennsport R1/2025/Spring|Spring Standings]] start in this stage *** 6 Teams are Split into ''2 Groups of 3'' where each group completes 3 Races each. *** {{Bgcolortext|up|1st Place}} of each group qualifies for the '''Group Stage'''. *** {{Bgcolortext|stay|2nd Place}} of each group proceed to a ''Race-Off''. *** The best {{Bgcolortext|staydown|3rd Place}} Team between both groups proceeds to the ''Race-Off'', the remaining team is {{Bgcolortext|down|Eliminated}}
* '''Race-Off - ''July 8th, 2025'' ** The 3 Teams participating in the ''Race-Off'' will compete in 1 Race. *** {{Bgcolortext|up|1st Place}} in the Race-Off qualifies for '''Group Stage'''. *** The remaining 2 Teams are {{Bgcolortext|down|Eliminated}}.
* '''Group Stage - ''July 9th, 2025'' ** 1st-3rd Place in [[Rennsport R1/2025/Spring|Spring Standings]] start in this stage joined by the 2 '''Last Chance Stage Group Winners''' and The '''Race-Off Winner'''. *** 6 Teams compete in a ''Round-Robin'' Format. Each Team completing 4 Races each. *** {{Bgcolortext|up|Top 3}} qualify for the {{Bgcolortext|up|'''Upper Braket'''}}. *** {{Bgcolortext|stay|4th-5th Place}} qualify for the {{Bgcolortext|stay|'''Lower Braket'''}}. *** {{Bgcolortext|down|6th Place}} is {{Bgcolortext|down|Eliminated}}
* '''Bracket Stage - ''July 10th, 2025'' ** In the '''Upper Bracket''', The Top 3 Teams from the ''Group Stage'' compete in a 3 race series. *** {{Bgcolortext|up|1st and 2nd Place}} qualify for the {{Bgcolortext|up|'''Finals'''}}. *** {{Bgcolortext|stay|3rd Place}} drop to the {{Bgcolortext|stay|'''Lower Braket'''}}. ** In the '''Lower Bracket''', 4th and 5th Teams from ''Group Stage'' alongside the ''Upper Bracket'' 3rd Place Team will compete in a 3 race series. *** {{Bgcolortext|up|1st Place}} qualifies for the {{Bgcolortext|up|'''Finals'''}}. *** {{Bgcolortext|down|2nd and 3rd Place}} are {{Bgcolortext|down|Eliminated}}.
* '''Finals - ''July 11th, 2025'' ** Top 2 from the ''Upper Bracket'' and Top 1 from the ''Lower Bracket'' compete in a minimum of 4 races and a maximum of a 8 race series with '''Finalist Mode''' enabled. *** '''Finalist Mode''' is Achieved by Reaching ''250pts''. Once reached, a team's driven that wins a race after reaching '''Finalist Mode''' are declared the winners. *** if a '''Finalist Mode''' victory is not reached by Race 8, the team with the most points is declared the winner.
